description: This file contains unit tests for the 'OneHot' GPU delegate component in TensorFlow Lite using the Metal backend. It imports necessary TensorFlow Lite testing utilities and defines a test case class 'OneHotMetalTest' with two test methods verifying the functionality of 'OneHotTest' and 'OneHotBatchTest'.

classes.name: OneHotMetalTest
classes.description: A XCTestCase class for testing the 'OneHot' GPU delegate functionality with Metal backend.

methods.name: testOneHot
methods.description: Tests the basic 'OneHot' operation on the GPU delegate environment, asserting that the status returned is OK.

methods.name: testOneHotBatch
methods.description: Tests the batched 'OneHot' operation, also asserting success via status check.
